name: publishing_state_read
title: Read publish state
description: One publish-state read per call, by exactly one id argument. output_id (rxpt_… export or comp_… composition, optional kind hint) returns the output's canonical publish_state envelopes per destination package. approval_id returns one reviewable package's publish_state including media/copy/destination readiness and next action. publish_record_id polls a queued attempt across queued, publishing, provider-accepted, published, failed, uncertain, reconciled, removed, and cleanup-failed states, including exact external URLs and recovery actions. The result carries subject: output | package | publish_record.

output_id.description: Output public ID (rxpt_… export or comp_… composition). Exactly one id argument.

kind.description: Optional output kind hint, only with output_id.

approval_id.description: Approval item (package) public ID. Exactly one id argument.

publish_record_id.description: Publish record public ID. Exactly one id argument.
